note: Build inputs for Silvies Valley Ranch; `make fetch NAME=silvies` puts them in place (pipeline/fetch_raw.py). raw/overpass.geojson is also committed. export.geojson = Overpass export (2026-10-25), clipped to the world + 300 m by clip_osm.py; map.osm = openstreetmap.org export of the same box, not used. _ags_eb4f76b6 = DOGAMI DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth, feet), exportImage at 1 m, box x 339750-342300 / y 4879200-4881550 EPSG:32611. The four _ags_*.jpg = OSIP 2024 quarters at 0.5 m of the same box (cc6d121f NW, 8535d091 NE, f70236de SW, a35cde54 SE, identified by looking), mosaicked by make_ortho.py. craddock.webp, Hankins.webp, chief.egan.webp, mcvgeighs.gauntlet.webp = the club's hole maps with yardages (look only; copies in reference/). or2020_johnday_J1476256.zip = NOAA Data Access Viewer job of the 2019-2020 OLC Upper John Day lidar (flown 11 Aug 2020), one LAZ over the box (689 MB, not in git), extracted to raw/laz/. _ags_f865b3b0 = DOGAMI CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC on the box (75 % nodata over the course; not used).
